name: auth-security-skill
description: Two Claude Code skills for authentication security — one audits an auth implementation for user enumeration, timing attacks, token forgery and broken authorization; the other hardens it. Includes a runnable MERN (Node.js/Express/React) demo with paired vulnerable and hardened auth stacks.
author: Kashif Raza <https://www.linkedin.com/in/kashif-raza-se>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @auth-lab/backend" "npm run dev -w @auth-lab/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @auth-lab/backend && npm run build -w @auth-lab/frontend && npm run build -w @auth-lab/constant-time-auth
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @auth-lab/backend" "npm run start -w @auth-lab/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @auth-lab/backend && npm run test -w @auth-lab/constant-time-auth && npm run test:skills
